Name: Fluid Combat
Author: asdnex5432
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Smoother combat with movement during attacks, attack cancellation, and held-button repetition. [/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]1. Install SMAPI.
2. Extract `FluidCombat` into your game's `Mods` folder.
3. Launch through SMAPI. Configure with Generic Mod Config Menu or the generated `config.json`.[/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]- Move during melee attacks, weapon specials, and slingshot charging.
- Cancel melee attacks into specials and specials into attacks. Special cooldowns still apply.
- Hold buttons to repeat melee attacks or specials.
- Face the mouse cursor when starting melee attacks and specials.
- Adjust combat movement speed and toggle the movement hop.[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]- SMAPI 4.5.2+.
- Optional: Generic Mod Config Menu.[/color]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Thanks to the SMAPI, Harmony, and Generic Mod Config Menu developers. [/color]
